# Next.js 15 Starter Repository — Full Documentation

> Production-grade Next.js 15 starter repository built with Tailwind CSS v4, ESLint 9 Flat Config, TypeScript, and automated Git workflows.

This document contains the complete technical specifications, guidelines, and structural patterns for direct ingestion by AI models, agents, and IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot).

---

# 1. Project Architecture

The repository follows a clean, feature-driven structure built on Next.js 15 App Router:

```text
.
├── app/
│   ├── (marketing)/      # Route group for landing/marketing pages (uses Lenis smooth scroll)
│   ├── (dashboard)/      # Route group for app/dashboard (standard native scrolling)
│   ├── layout.tsx        # Root layout with Geist font & ThemeProvider
│   ├── globals.css       # Tailwind CSS v4 imports and theme variables
│   ├── not-found.tsx     # Global 404 page
│   ├── providers.tsx     # Client-side ThemeProvider (next-themes)
│   ├── robots.ts         # Robots.txt generator for AI crawlers
│   └── sitemap.ts        # Dynamic XML sitemap generator
├── components/           # Reusable UI components
├── public/               # Static assets & AI metadata (llms.txt, llms-full.txt)
├── .husky/               # Husky v9 git hooks (pre-commit, commit-msg)
├── eslint.config.mjs     # Native ESLint 9 Flat Config
├── postcss.config.mjs    # Tailwind v4 PostCSS configuration
└── package.json          # Project scripts and dependency tree
